headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.39
summary: The Xbox friends card moved out of the content download column and now sits under content management as its own card, so both columns use their space properly.

items.text: The friends card used to be nested inside the content download card, which left it squeezed against that column's rows while the content management column had a large empty gap under its three entries. It is now its own card directly under content management, with the same header, divider and card chrome as the other columns.
